topic.para: This article describes the migration from ⪪ on &slsa; 11 or 12 to &rmt; on &slsa; 15.

warning.title: Read this section carefully
warning.para: Carefully read this section. It contains vital information about the migration process.

listitem.para: We recommend that you install &rmt; on a newly installed &slsa; 15 host. &rmt; is not a complete replacement for ⪪. It has a different workflow than ⪪ and only supports registering &sls; 12 systems and newer.
The settings of staged repositories are not exported from ⪪. Repositories that have been marked to be mirrored are exported.
It is only possible to export repositories that are marked for mirroring.
Products no longer available on the organization subscriptions will not be available on &rmt;.
Systems and their activated products are exported. ⪪ client jobs and patch status are not exported from ⪪.
